title: Resonance Asceticism
subtitle: Selective Attenuation as a Resonance-Time Trajectory
purpose: Investigate whether deliberate, bounded, and reversible modulation of excitation can reveal temporal structure in system behavior that may remain obscured under continuous excitation or static before-and-after observation.
central_proposition: The trajectory, rather than the isolated state, is the primary phenomenon under investigation.
scope_note: Resonance Asceticism treats ascetic constraint as selective attenuation rather than deprivation as an end in itself. The framework examines emergence, persistence, decay, recurrence, adaptation, stabilization, restoration, and drift across Resonance-Time. RTT-derived notation and case-study operators remain conceptual unless independently operationalized and empirically validated.

principles.not_every_excitation_deserves_equal_band: Availability of an excitation does not establish that it should receive continued attention or amplification.
principles.constraint_is_instrumental: Constraint is an observational and regulatory instrument rather than an intrinsic objective.
principles.minimum_effective_constraint: Apply the least attenuation necessary to restore discrimination or expose the temporal behavior under investigation.
principles.subtraction_can_reveal_structure: Reducing continuous excitation may expose emergence, persistence, decay, recurrence, adaptation, or other temporal relationships that were previously obscured.
principles.substrate_must_be_preserved: An intervention that degrades the system required for observation and coherent participation is not treated as successful merely because excitation decreases.
principles.felt_coherence_is_not_verified_coherence: Subjective clarity remains open to contradiction, external evidence, corrective exposure, and reassessment.
principles.trajectory_precedes_snapshot: Static measurements are treated as temporal slices through a larger trajectory rather than complete descriptions of system behavior.
principles.constraint_must_remain_revisable: Attenuation should remain reversible and subject to reassessment so that a useful operator does not silently become an identity boundary or dogma.

trajectory.primary_object: Ordered time-dependent system trajectory rather than isolated pre-intervention and post-intervention states.
trajectory.central_question: What temporal structure becomes observable when continuous excitation is deliberately and reversibly modulated?

measurement_view.principle: Collect the trajectory; derive the snapshots.
measurement_view.raw_observation: O_i = {t_i, e_i, lambda_i, N_i, R_i, Sigma_i, C_E_i}
measurement_view.sampling_rule: Sampling frequency should be selected according to the shortest temporal phenomenon the study intends to resolve.
measurement_view.interpretive_boundary: Operational definition enables measurement but does not by itself establish reliability, construct validity, empirical validation, or generalizability.

threshold_governance.principle: Evidence provenance, evidence strength, threshold result, and acceptance status are recorded independently.

boundary_conditions.physical_claim: The case study does not require Silence, Noise, Resonance, substrate integrity, or Resonance-Time trajectory variables to be treated as established physical quantities.
boundary_conditions.empirical_claim: RTT-derived constructs and Resonance Asceticism operators require explicit operationalization and validation before quantitative empirical interpretation.
boundary_conditions.asceticism_claim: Ascetic constraint is treated here as a structural and observational mechanism of selective attenuation rather than as an assertion that deprivation is inherently beneficial.
boundary_conditions.observer_claim: The observer remains part of the observed system; apparent coherence must therefore remain open to corrective evidence.
boundary_conditions.evidence_rule: External scholarship may support conceptual context, measurement selection, or empirical comparison without thereby validating RTT or Resonance Asceticism.

illustrative_application.name: Notification-Mediated Attentional Interruption
illustrative_application.attenuation: selective reduction of predefined notification categories
illustrative_application.observation: Repeated measurement across baseline, attenuation, adaptation, and restoration phases.
illustrative_application.trajectory_question: How do interference, goal-congruent performance, persistence, adaptation, and restoration change through time when notification coupling is deliberately modulated?
illustrative_application.boundary_note: The example illustrates an empirical domain for testing selective attenuation. It does not establish that notifications are inherently harmful or that notification research validates RTT.

closing_principles: Not every excitation deserves equal bandwidth.
Use the least constraint necessary to restore discrimination.
Severity is not evidence of coherence.
Felt coherence is not verified coherence.
Collect the trajectory; derive the snapshots.
The measurements are temporal slices; the trajectory connecting them is the phenomenon under investigation.
closing_statement: Resonance Asceticism is not primarily the study of reduced excitation. It is the deliberate modulation of excitation and coupling in order to observe how resonance emerges, persists, decays, recurs, adapts, and reorganizes through time.
